import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import dataclasses, importlib.metadata, json, pathlib, sys
import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import dataclasses, importlib.metadata, json, pathlib, sys
import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()
